Class EventService

java.lang.Object
com.example.activityscheduler.event.service.EventService
@Service @Transactional public class EventService extends Object
Service class for managing Event entities and providing business logic for event operations. Events are associated with organizations and validated against organization existence.

  • Method Details

    • createEvent

      public Event createEvent(EventCreationRequest request)
      Creates a new event from a creation request. The event ID is automatically generated. After validating organization exists, user exists (if provided), and user is a member of the organization.
      Parameters:
      request - the event creation request
      Returns:
      the created event
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if organization does not exist, user does not exist, user is not a member of the organization, or invalid data

    • updateEvent

      public Event updateEvent(String eventId, EventUpdateRequest request)
      Updates an existing event from an update request. The event ID, creation timestamp, and creator are preserved. After validating organization exists.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event to update
      request - the event update request
      Returns:
      the updated event
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if organization does not exist or invalid data

    • deleteEvent

      public void deleteEvent(String eventId, String userId)
      Deletes an event by its ID. Only the event creator can delete the event.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the event ID to delete
      userId - the user ID of the actor attempting to delete the event
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the event is not found or the user is not the event creator
